passage.zh: 「花間一壺酒，獨酌無相親」，這兩句詩表達出李白的心情。
passage.py: “Huājiān yìhújiǔ, dúzhuó wú xiāngqīn”, zhè liǎngjùshī biǎodá chū Lǐbái de xīnqíng.
passage.en: "Among the flowers, a pot of wine; I drink alone, with no one close." These two lines express Li Bai's mood.

passage.zh: 他在奼紫嫣紅的花叢間，擺上一壺酒。
passage.py: Tā zài chàzǐyānhóng de huācóng jiān, bǎi shàng yìhújiǔ.
passage.en: Amid a riot of colorful flowers, he sets out a pot of wine.

passage.zh: 在醺然的狀態下，邀了天上的明月一起對飲。
passage.py: Zài xūn rán de zhuàngtài xià, yāo le tiānshàng de míngyuè yìqǐ duìyǐn.
passage.en: Tipsy, he invites the bright moon in the sky to drink with him.

passage.zh: 這樣的良辰美景，應該是三五好友，知心共享的時刻，李白卻只能喟嘆。
passage.py: Zhèyàng de liángchénměijǐng, yīnggāi shì sānwǔ hǎoyǒu, zhīxīn gòngxiǎng de shíkè, Lǐbái què zhǐnéng kuìtàn.
passage.en: Such a beautiful moment ought to be shared with a few good friends and kindred spirits, yet Li Bai can only sigh.

passage.zh: 月亮、李白與李白的影子，對影成三人。
passage.py: Yuèliàng, Lǐbái yǔ Lǐbái de yǐngzi, duì yǐngchéng sānrén.
passage.en: The moon, Li Bai and Li Bai's shadow—facing his shadow, they make three.

passage.zh: 月亮不會飲酒，和自己的影子飲酒更是平添寂寞。
passage.py: Yuèliàng búhuì yǐnjiǔ, hé zìjǐ de yǐngzi yǐnjiǔ gèngshì Píngtiān jìmò.
passage.en: The moon can't drink, and drinking with one's own shadow only adds to the loneliness.

passage.zh: 但是，李白終究灑脫。
passage.py: Dànshì, Lǐbái zhōngjiū sǎtuō.
passage.en: But Li Bai is free-spirited after all.

passage.zh: 趁著春光正盛，恣意歌詠，至歡快處，手舞足蹈不也酣暢淋漓、大快人心。
passage.py: Chèn zhe chūnguāng zhèng shèng, zìyì gēyǒng, zhì huānkuài chù, shǒuwǔzúdǎo bù yě hānchànglínlí, dàkuàirénxīn.
passage.en: While spring is at its height, he sings as he pleases, and when he reaches the height of joy, dancing with abandon is utterly exhilarating and deeply satisfying.

passage.zh: 李白就這樣從最初的落寞，到任著自己的心情，在月下舞著、蹈著、唱著，還和白玉盤有了天際渺渺之約。
passage.py: Lǐbái jiù zhèyàng cóng zuìchū de luòmò, dàorèn zhe zìjǐ de xīnqíng, zài yuè xià wǔzhe, dǎozhe, chàngzhe, hái hé Báiyù pán yǒu le tiānjì miǎomiǎo zhī yuē.
passage.en: Thus Li Bai goes from initial desolation to following his heart, dancing, stepping and singing under the moon, and even makes a distant appointment beyond the sky with the white jade plate (the moon).

passage.zh: 李白不需要走到人生的困境，才懂得駐足欣賞眼前的風景，他總是隨走隨看隨領略。
passage.py: Lǐbái bù xūyào zǒu dào rénshēng de kùnjìng, cái dǒngde zhùzú xīnshǎng yǎnqián de fēngjǐng, tā zǒngshì suí zǒusuí kànsuí lǐnglüè.
passage.en: Li Bai doesn't need to reach life's dead end to learn to stop and admire the scenery before him; he always takes things in as he goes.

passage.zh: 即便孤身一人，總有艱辛，他也能將之轉化與天地同歡，而這番了悟，妙筆一揮，遂成詩裡行間的風景。
passage.py: Jíbiàn gūshēnyìrén, zǒng yǒu jiānxīn, tā yě néng jiāng zhī zhuǎnhuà yǔ tiāndì tónghuān, ér zhè fān le wù, miàobǐ yì huī, suì chéng shī lǐ hángjiān de fēngjǐng.
passage.en: Even alone, and with hardship always present, he can turn it into rejoicing with heaven and earth; and this realization, with a stroke of his marvelous brush, becomes the scenery between the lines of his poems.

passage.zh: 在我看來，人生泰半是挫折與苦難。
passage.py: Zàiwǒkànlái, rénshēng Tàibàn shì cuòzhé yǔ kǔnàn.
passage.en: In my view, most of life is setbacks and suffering.

passage.zh: 但是，若偕李白同行，每每到水窮處時，必定聽見李白放聲大歌。
passage.py: Dànshì, ruò xié Lǐbái tóngháng, měiměi dào shuǐ qióng chù shí, bìdìng tīngjiàn Lǐbái fàngshēng dàgē.
passage.en: But if you travel with Li Bai, whenever you come to where the water ends, you will surely hear Li Bai singing at the top of his voice.

passage.zh: 伴著歌聲，試著將挫折烹調成一盤下酒菜。
passage.py: Bànzhe gēshēng, shìzhe jiāng cuòzhé pēngtiáo chéng yìpán xiàjiǔcài.
passage.en: Accompanied by the song, try to cook your setbacks into a dish to go with wine.

passage.zh: 咀嚼於舌尖的況味，終將消化於人生的坦然。
passage.py: Jǔjué yú shéjiān de Kuàngwèi, zhōngjiāng xiāohuà yú rénshēng de tǎnrán.
passage.en: The flavor savored on the tip of the tongue will in the end be digested into life's equanimity.

passage.zh: 多數人以為，超大質量黑洞應存在於巨大星系的中心位置。
passage.py: Duōshù rén yǐwéi, chāodà zhìliàng Hēidòng yīng cúnzài yú jùdà xīngxì de zhōngxīn wèizhì.
passage.en: Most people think supermassive black holes should be found at the center of huge galaxies.

passage.zh: 但日前，已有天文學家在銀河系邊緣，發現了幾十個超大質量黑洞。
passage.py: Dàn rìqián, yǐyǒu tiānwénxuéjiā zài yínhéxì biānyuán, fāxiàn le jǐshí ge chāodà zhìliàng Hēidòng.
passage.en: But recently, astronomers have found dozens of supermassive black holes at the edge of the Milky Way.

passage.zh: 這些黑洞在環繞銀河系主體，由恆星和氣體構成近似於球形的「恆星暈」區域中閒逛著。
passage.py: Zhèxiē Hēidòng zài huánrào yínhéxì zhǔtǐ, yóu Héngxīng hé qìtǐ gòuchéng jìnsìyú qiúxíng de “Héngxīng yūn” qūyù zhōng xiánguàng zhe.
passage.en: These black holes are wandering in the nearly spherical "stellar halo" region of stars and gas that surrounds the main body of the Milky Way.

passage.zh: 天文學家認為，黑洞之所以存在於宿主星系邊緣的現象，是來自星系合併的結果，這現象經常發生在一個不斷膨脹的宇宙中。
passage.py: Tiānwénxuéjiā rènwéi, Hēidòng zhīsuǒyǐ cúnzài yú sùzhǔ xīngxì biānyuán de xiànxiàng, shì láizì xīngxì hébìng de jiéguǒ, zhè xiànxiàng jīngcháng fāshēng zài yí ge búduàn péngzhàng de yǔzhòu zhōng.
passage.en: Astronomers believe black holes exist at the edge of their host galaxies as a result of galaxy mergers, which often happen in a constantly expanding universe.

passage.zh: 當一個較小的星系融入一個更大的主星系時，它會把自己中央的超大質量黑洞置於新的宿主星系上。
passage.py: Dāng yí ge jiàoxiǎo de xīngxì róngrù yí ge gèng dà de zhǔ xīngxì shí, tā huì bǎ zìjǐ zhōngyāng de chāodà zhìliàng Hēidòng zhìyú xīn de sùzhǔ xīngxì shàng.
passage.en: When a smaller galaxy merges into a larger main galaxy, it deposits its own central supermassive black hole in the new host galaxy.

passage.zh: 《天體物理學雜誌快報》刊發的研究報告進一步預測，與銀河系具有相近質量的星系，應該包含著不只一個超大質量的黑洞。
passage.py: «Tiāntǐ wùlǐxué zázhì kuàibào» kānfā de yánjiū bàogào jìnyíbù yùcè, yǔ yínhéxì jùyǒu xiāngjìn zhìliàng de xīngxì, yīnggāi bāohán zhe bù zhǐ yí ge chāodà zhìliàng de Hēidòng.
passage.en: A research report published in The Astrophysical Journal Letters further predicts that galaxies of similar mass to the Milky Way should contain more than one supermassive black hole.

passage.zh: 該報告的研究員表示，由於工具的限制，想直接論斷黑洞的存在是不可能的。
passage.py: Gāi bàogào de yánjiūyuán biǎoshì, yóuyú gōngjù de xiànzhì, xiǎng zhíjiē lùnduàn Hēidòng de cúnzài shì bù kěnéng de.
passage.en: The report's researchers say that because of the limits of instruments, it is impossible to determine directly that the black holes exist.

passage.zh: 即使想間接推斷它們是否存在，也必須要有更好的方法與手段才行。
passage.py: Jíshǐ xiǎng jiànjiē tuīduàn tāmen shìfǒu cúnzài, yě bìxū yào yǒu gènghǎo de fāngfǎ yǔ shǒuduàn cái xíng.
passage.en: Even to infer indirectly whether they exist, better methods and means are needed.

passage.zh: 因為，每 1000 億年左右，才能與影響太陽系的漫遊黑洞近距離接觸，從人類角度來看，其生發頻率極低；
passage.py: Yīnwèi, měi 1000 yìnián zuǒyòu, cáinéng yǔ yǐngxiǎng tàiyángxì de mànyóu Hēidòng jìnjùlí jiēchù, cóng rénlèi jiǎodù láikàn, qí shēngfà pínlǜ jí dī;
passage.en: Because a wandering black hole would come close to and affect the solar system only about once every 100 billion years—from a human perspective, an extremely low frequency;

passage.zh: 再加上，因為預測漫遊的超大質量黑洞位於離星系中心很遠且處於星系盤之外的地方，所以它們不太可能吸收增加更多的氣體，來膨脹規模，讓人類發現它們。
passage.py: Zài jiāshàng, yīnwèi yùcè mànyóu de chāodà zhìliàng Hēidòng wèiyú lí xīngxì zhōngxīn hěnyuǎn qiě chǔyú xīngxì pán zhīwài de dìfāng, suǒyǐ tāmen bútàikěnéng xīshōu zēngjiā gèngduō de qìtǐ, lái péngzhàng guīmó, ràng rénlèi fāxiàn tāmen.
passage.en: moreover, because the wandering supermassive black holes are predicted to be far from galactic centers and outside the galactic disk, they are unlikely to absorb more gas and grow in size so that humans could discover them.

passage.py: Měishātóng shì yìzhǒng héchéng lèi Yāpiàn de yàowù.

passage.zh: 1970 年代起，美國和歐洲國家主張由政府提供美沙酮給吸毒者，用來替代海洛因，幫助吸毒者戒除毒癮。
passage.py: 1970 niándài qǐ, Měiguó hé Ōuzhōu guójiā zhǔzhāng yóu zhèngfǔ tígōng Měishātóng gěi xīdúzhě, yònglái tìdài Hǎiluòyīn, bāngzhù xīdúzhě jièchú dúyǐn.
passage.en: From the 1970s, the US and European countries advocated that the government provide methadone to drug users as a substitute for heroin, to help them kick their addiction.

passage.zh: 由於戒除海洛因的過程非常痛苦，極難根除，美沙酮作為一個毒性較低的藥品，能幫助吸毒者在無法戒除毒癮的情況下，緩解毒癮、抗拒使用海洛因的誘惑。
passage.py: Yóuyú jièchú Hǎiluòyīn de guòchéng fēicháng tòngkǔ, jínán gēnchú, Měishātóng zuòwéi yí ge dúxìng jiàodī de yàopǐn, néng bāngzhù xīdúzhě zài wúfǎ jièchú dúyǐn de qíngkuàng xià, huǎnjiě dúyǐn, kàngjù shǐyòng Hǎiluòyīn de yòuhuò.
passage.en: Because quitting heroin is extremely painful and very hard to achieve completely, methadone, as a less toxic drug, can help users who can't quit to ease their craving and resist the temptation of heroin.

passage.zh: 美沙酮的使用時有爭議。
passage.py: Měishātóng de shǐyòng shí yǒu zhēngyì.
passage.en: The use of methadone has at times been controversial.

passage.zh: 台灣在九十年代初期，就有醫界人士建議政府引進美沙酮。
passage.py: Táiwān zài jiǔshíniándài chūqī, jiù yǒu yījiè rénshì jiànyì zhèngfǔ yǐnjìn Měishātóng.
passage.en: In the early 1990s, some in Taiwan's medical community suggested the government introduce methadone.

passage.zh: 不過當時研究顯示，大多服用美沙酮的毒癮患者必須終生服用，僅有不到 5%的人可以成功擺脫對美沙酮的依賴。
passage.py: Búguò dāngshí yánjiū xiǎnshì, dàduō fúyòng Měishātóng de dúyǐn huànzhě bìxū zhōngshēng fúyòng, jǐn yǒu búdào 5 % de rén kěyǐ chénggōng bǎituō duì Měishātóng de yīlài.
passage.en: But research at the time showed that most addicts on methadone had to take it for life; fewer than 5% could successfully free themselves of methadone dependence.

passage.zh: 使用美沙酮似乎是以毒攻毒的疑慮，讓這項提議始終停留在紙上談兵的階段。
passage.py: Shǐyòng Měishātóng sìhū shì yǐdúgōngdú de yílǜ, ràng zhèxiàng tíyì shǐzhōng tíngliú zài zhǐshàngtánbīng de jiēduàn.
passage.en: Doubts that using methadone seemed like fighting poison with poison kept the proposal stuck on paper.

passage.zh: 然而隨著毒品日益氾濫，不少專家不得不重新評估，認為使用美沙酮是兩害相權取其輕的做法。
passage.py: Rán'ér suízhe dúpǐn rìyì fànlàn, bùshǎo zhuānjiā bùdébù chóngxīn pínggū, rènwéi shǐyòng Měishātóng shì liǎnghàixiāngquán qǔqíqīng de zuòfǎ.
passage.en: However, as drugs became more and more widespread, many experts had to reassess and concluded that using methadone is choosing the lesser of two evils.

passage.zh: 海洛因市價極高，毒癮患者經常為了籌錢購買毒品鋌而走險、到處犯案，若由政府提供美沙酮給毒癮患者，就可降低因毒品而產生的社會犯罪。
passage.py: Hǎiluòyīn shìjià jí gāo, dúyǐn huànzhě jīngcháng wèile chóuqián gòumǎi dúpǐn tǐng'érzǒuxiǎn, dàochù fàn'àn, ruò yóu zhèngfǔ tígōng Měishātóng gěi dúyǐn huànzhě, jiù kě jiàngdī yīn dúpǐn ér chǎnshēng de shèhuì fànzuì.
passage.en: Heroin is extremely expensive, and addicts often take desperate risks and commit crimes everywhere to raise money for drugs; if the government provides methadone to addicts, drug-related crime in society can be reduced.

passage.zh: 此外，自從愛滋病出現後，由於口服的美沙酮不必由靜脈注射，可以避免愛滋感染，更是不少國家反毒、抗愛滋的重要工具。
passage.py: Cǐwài, zìcóng àizībìng chūxiàn hòu, yóuyú kǒufú de Měishātóng búbì yóu jìngmàizhùshè, kěyǐ bìmiǎn Àizī gǎnrǎn, gèngshì bùshǎo guójiā fǎndú, kàng Àizī de zhòngyào gōngjù.
passage.en: In addition, since the appearance of AIDS, because oral methadone doesn't need to be injected into a vein, it can prevent HIV infection, making it an important tool for many countries against both drugs and AIDS.

passage.zh: 專家表示，使用美沙酮來治療毒癮代表一種觀念的轉變。
passage.py: Zhuānjiā biǎoshì, shǐyòng Měishātóng lái zhìliáo dúyǐn dàibiǎo yìzhǒng guānniàn de zhuǎnbiàn.
passage.en: Experts say using methadone to treat addiction represents a change in thinking.

passage.zh: 以前社會把吸食海洛因的人視為犯人，一旦抓到吸毒者就交由法律制裁。
passage.py: Yǐqián shèhuì bǎ xīshí Hǎiluòyīn de rén shìwèi fànrén, yídàn zhuā dào xīdúzhě jiù jiāoyóu fǎlǜzhìcái.
passage.en: In the past, society regarded heroin users as criminals; once caught, users were handed over to the law for punishment.

passage.zh: 但現在由政府提供美沙酮的做法則是將吸毒者視為病人，這表示社會應對病人提供醫療協助，而不是一味的限制與懲罰。
passage.py: Dàn xiànzài yóu zhèngfǔ tígōng Měishātóng de zuòfǎ zé shì jiāng xīdúzhě shìwèi bìngrén, zhè biǎoshì shèhuì yìngduì bìngrén tígōng yīliáo xiézhù, ér búshì yíwèi de xiànzhì yǔ chéngfá.
passage.en: But the government providing methadone now regards drug users as patients, which means society should give patients medical help rather than blindly restricting and punishing them.

passage.zh: 她獨行於瞎燈黑火的林道上，僅有些微月光從葉隙中透出。
passage.py: Tā dúxíng Yúxiā dēnghēi huǒ de líndào shàng, jǐn yǒuxiē wēi yuèguāng cóng yèxì zhōng tòuchū.
passage.en: She walked alone along the pitch-dark forest path, with only a little moonlight filtering through the gaps in the leaves.

passage.zh: 臨下山前，家中長輩再三囑咐，此去求援，不可妄生事端，她的拳腳功夫僅能自保，若不是族中男子皆已上戰場廝殺，萬萬是不能讓她一個女子孤身上路。
passage.py: Línxià shānqián, jiāzhōng zhǎngbèi zàisān zhǔfù, cǐqù qiúyuán, bùkě wàngshēng shìduān, tā de quánjiǎo gōngfu jǐn néng zìbǎo, ruò búshì zú zhōng nánzi jiē yǐshàng zhànchǎng sīshā, wànwàn shì bùnéng ràng tā yí ge nǚzǐ gūshēn Shànglù.
passage.en: Before she came down the mountain, the elders of her family had repeatedly told her that on this trip to seek help she must not stir up trouble; her martial arts were only good enough to protect herself, and if all the men of the clan hadn't already gone off to fight in the war, they would never have let a girl set out alone.

passage.zh: 是以一切只求護得自身周全，快去快回即可。
passage.py: Shì yǐ yíqiè zhǐqiú hù de zìshēn Zhōuquán, kuàiqùkuàihuí jíkě.
passage.en: So she only sought to keep herself safe and go and come back quickly.

passage.zh: 一路行來，她不僅低調，且不停地變換交通工具，先是乘舟走水十來天，接著易舟為馬，在馬上又折騰了十來天。
passage.py: Yílùxíng lái, tā bùjǐn dīdiào, qiě bùtíng de biànhuàn jiāotōnggōngjù, xiānshì Chéngzhōu zǒushuǐ shíláitiān, jiēzhe Yìzhōu wèi Mǎ, zài mǎshàng yòu zhēteng le shíláitiān.
passage.en: All the way she kept a low profile and kept changing her means of travel: first more than ten days by boat on the water, then trading the boat for a horse and struggling on horseback for another ten days or so.

passage.zh: 就剩最後這幾里路時，她才改由步行。
passage.py: Jiù shèng zuìhòu zhè jǐlǐ lù shí, tā cái gǎiyóu bùxíng.
passage.en: Only for these last few miles had she switched to walking.

passage.zh: 原以為安全的地兒，眼下卻讓她有不寒而慄之感。
passage.py: Yuányǐwéi ānquán de dìr, yǎnxià què ràng tā yǒu bùhán'érlì zhī gǎn.
passage.en: The place she had thought safe now sent a chill down her spine.

passage.zh: 前方突地傳來沙沙聲，她下意識退後兩步，卻見林中飛鳥穿過樹梢，她有些「惱怒」，暗啐膽小。
passage.py: Qiánfāng tūdì chuánlái Shāshāshēng, tā xiàyìshí tuìhòu liǎngbù, què jiàn línzhōng fēiniǎo chuānguò shùshāo, tā yǒuxiē “Nǎonù”, àn cuì dǎnxiǎo.
passage.en: Suddenly a rustling came from ahead. She instinctively stepped back two paces, only to see birds flying through the treetops; she was a little "annoyed," silently scolding herself for being a coward.

passage.zh: 驀地，身後傳來虛空劃破之聲。
passage.py: Mòdì, shēnhòu chuánlái xūkōng huàpò zhī shēng.
passage.en: All of a sudden, from behind came the sound of something slicing through the air.

passage.zh: 她略側頭回看，眼角已閃過一道疾光。
passage.py: Tā lüè cè tóu huíkàn, yǎnjiǎo yǐ shǎnguò yídào jíguāng.
passage.en: She turned her head slightly to look back, and a flash of light had already shot past the corner of her eye.

passage.zh: 堪堪轉身之際，就見劍尖在眼前一晃，幸得她偏頭一閃，並朝對方腰處撞去。
passage.py: Kānkān zhuǎnshēn zhījì, jiù jiàn jiànjiān zài yǎnqián yìhuǎng, xìngde tā piāntóu yì shǎn, bìng cháo duìfāng yāo chù zhuàng qù.
passage.en: Just as she turned around, she saw a sword tip flash before her eyes; luckily she dodged her head aside and rammed toward the attacker's waist.

passage.zh: 她也不知道這一招是否有效，只是拼盡全身的力氣，狠地一撞。
passage.py: Tā yě bù zhīdào zhè yìzhāo shìfǒu yǒuxiào, zhǐshì pīnjǐn quánshēn de lìqì, hěndì yízhuàng.
passage.en: She didn't know whether this move would work; she just rammed hard with all her strength.

passage.zh: 這一來一往，間刻不能容髮之際，她都沒察覺自己一顆心已經提到了嗓子眼兒，堵得呼吸都倍顯艱難。
passage.py: Zhè yìláiyìwǎng, jiānkè bùnéng róngfā zhījì, tā dōu méi chájué zìjǐ yìkē xīn yǐjīng tídào le sǎngziyǎnr, dǔ de hūxī dōu bèi xiǎn jiānnán.
passage.en: In this exchange, with not a hair's breadth to spare, she didn't even notice that her heart was in her throat, blocking it so that even breathing was twice as hard.

passage.zh: 幸得這一撞，教來者失了準頭，削掉她幾縷青絲。
passage.py: Xìngde zhèyī zhuàng, jiāo láizhě shī le zhǔntou, xuēdiào tā jǐlǚ qīngsī.
passage.en: Luckily this ram threw the attacker off aim, and only a few strands of her hair were sliced off.

passage.zh: 但這一撞，也叫她看清來者何人，一聲驚呼幾乎要從喉間溢出，今天真是給阿爹應了「養虎為患」這句話啊！
passage.py: Dàn zhèyī zhuàng, yě jiào tā kànqīng láizhě hérén, yìshēng jīnghū jīhū yào cóng hóujiān yìchū, jīntiān zhēnshì gěi Ādiē yìng le “Yǎnghǔwéihuàn” zhè jù huà a!
passage.en: But the ram also let her see clearly who the attacker was; a cry of shock almost escaped her throat—today her father's saying "raising a tiger invites disaster" had truly come true!

passage.zh: 來人穩住身形，又是一連串凌厲攻勢，她左支右絀閃躲地甚是狼狽。
passage.py: Lái rén wěnzhù shēnxíng, yòu shì yìliánchuàn Línglìgōngshì, tā zuǒzhīyòuchù shǎnduǒ de shènshì lángbèi.
passage.en: The attacker steadied himself and launched another series of fierce attacks; she dodged left and right in great disarray.

passage.zh: 反射性地憶起了與這人無猜的歲月，心下淒苦。
passage.py: Fǎnshèxìng de yìqǐ le yǔ zhèrén wúcāi de suìyuè, xīnxià qīkǔ.
passage.en: By reflex she recalled the innocent years she had spent with this person, and her heart filled with bitterness.

passage.zh: 喉頭一甜、滿嘴鹹腥。
passage.py: Hóutóu yì tián, Mǎnzuǐ xián xīng.
passage.en: A sweet taste rose in her throat and her mouth filled with the salty taste of blood.

passage.zh: 眼下任務不僅完成不了，想她不過一十八歲的年華或許也將了結在此。
passage.py: Yǎnxià rènwù bùjǐn wánchéng bùliǎo, xiǎng tā búguò yīshíbāsuì de niánhuá huòxǔ yě jiāng liǎojié zài cǐ.
passage.en: Now not only could she not complete her mission, but her life, only eighteen years long, might also end here.

passage.py: Chūnqiūshíqī, Guǎnzhòng tuī “Guānshān hǎi” shuìfù zhèngcè, běn zhe “Pǔtiānzhīxià, Mòfēi Wángtǔ” de zhèngzhì sīwéi, yìyù shōujǐn yúzé Shānchuān zhī lìlái qiánghuà guójiā jīngjì.
passage.en: In the Spring and Autumn period, Guan Zhong promoted the "state control of mountains and seas" tax policy; based on the political thinking that "all land under heaven belongs to the king," he sought to take all the profits of fisheries, marshes, mountains and rivers to strengthen the state's economy.

passage.zh: 到了西漢，朝廷明令將鹽、鐵、酒等重要經濟事業收歸國有，並嚴禁百姓私售。
passage.py: Dào le Xīhàn, Cháotíng mínglìng jiāngyán, tiě, jiǔ děng zhòngyào jīngjì shìyè shōuguīguóyǒu, bìng yánjìn bǎixìng sīshòu.
passage.en: By the Western Han, the court explicitly nationalized salt, iron, wine and other important economic enterprises, and strictly forbade the common people to sell them privately.

passage.zh: 官、私兩分

passage.en: The split between official and private

passage.zh: 食鹽是民生必需品，大眾的需求量大，背後龐大的利潤可想而知，朝廷為擴充國庫，與民爭利，一方面限制可專賣的店家數，一方面又以嚴刑峻法打壓私鹽販售，如若販售私鹽罪證確鑿，輕則流放，重則處死，從西漢以降至有清一朝，刑法的嚴峻，不亞於當今販售毒品的罪責。
passage.py: Shíyán shì mínshēng bìxūpǐn, dàzhòng de xūqiúliàng dà, bèihòu pángdà de lìrùn kěxiǎng'érzhī, Cháotíng wèi kuòchōng guókù, yǔmínzhēnglì, yìfāngmiàn xiànzhì kě zhuānmài de diànjiā shù, yìfāngmiàn yòu yǐ yánxíngjùnfǎ dǎyā sīyán fànshòu, rúruò fànshòu sīyán zuìzhèngquèzáo, qīng zé liúfàng, zhòng zé chǔsǐ, cóng Xīhàn yǐ jiàngzhì yǒu qīng yìzhāo, xíngfǎ de yánjùn, búyàyú dāngjīn fànshòu dúpǐn de zuìzé.
passage.en: Salt is a daily necessity in great demand, and the huge profits behind it can be imagined. To fill the treasury, the court competed with the people for profit: on the one hand it limited the number of shops allowed to sell under the monopoly, and on the other it suppressed private salt sales with harsh laws. If guilt in selling private salt was proven, the lighter penalty was exile and the heavier was death. From the Western Han down to the Qing dynasty, the severity of these penalties was no less than that for drug dealing today.

passage.en: People today should know that "using the past as a mirror, one can know the rise and fall of dynasties." The mirror of history always reflects past mistakes, reminding future decision-makers as they make their decisions.
